scope: Post-fit development consistency diagnostic against previously inspected CDM/control means. Local increase in effective w only; no dose mapping, response fit, final validation, or model installation.

plan.scope: Post-fit development consistency diagnostic against previously inspected CDM/control means. Local increase in effective w only; no dose mapping, response fit, final validation, or model installation.
plan.perturbation: For each complete selected recurrent fit, keep tau_v,gap,g,A_on,A_off fixed. Retain base and both w*(1 +/- fraction) flash responses for every fraction. Primary local derivative is the forward difference at the smallest predeclared step; central differences assess numerical/sign stability. No step chosen from agreement.
plan.observation: Same fixed zero-state20ms flash and63 trailing1/120s bins; same numerical positivity requirement. No natural sequence or output normalization is refitted.
plan.comparison: All eight named cell/condition/polarity pairs. Primary early[0,.05] and late[.05,.25] raw window-change signs; raw recovery and whole windows plus whole-trace direction cosine descriptive. Signs use threshold1e-9 solely to flag numerical ambiguity, not statistical significance. A model has identical nominal high/low flash inputs, so its directions are duplicated across labels.
plan.interpretation: Failure at these selected control fits rejects local feedback-strength-only directional consistency for this observation model; it does not exclude larger nonlinear changes, other parameters, brightness effects, or real octopamine biology. Matching signs does not establish effect size, cause, independent animals, chemical efficacy, or a concentration-response law.
